ads.text: Telugu: మీ ఇంటి విలువను పెంచండి మరియు పర్యావరణాన్ని రక్షించండి. అత్యాధునిక టెక్నాలజీతో కూడిన ఆన్-గ్రిడ్ సోలార్ సిస్టమ్స్‌ను మేము అందిస్తున్నాము. ఎటువంటి నిర్వహణ ఖర్చు లేకుండా దశాబ్దాల పాటు ఉచిత విద్యుత్తును పొందండి. (Increase your home's value and protect the environment with modern-technology on-grid solar systems and decades of free electricity.)

Stop Paying High Current Bills! Kapil Powerతో మీ ఇంటినే పవర్ హౌస్‌గా మార్చుకోండి. Zero Electricity Bills (reduce your current bill up to 90%), Government Subsidy (PM Surya Ghar), Premium Panels (25 years warranty), Expert Installation (20+ years experience), Trusted Brand (1000+ happy customers).

ad_library.summary: Kapil Power & Infra is running 2 active Telugu ads on Meta - one since 14 September 2026 (on-grid solar systems) and one since 6 October 2026 (reduce your bill by 90%, 1000+ happy customers) - and both send the click into a Facebook lead form. Kapil Power is the solar arm of the Kapil Group, a Hyderabad household name since 1981, with 25+ years in solar, TGREDCO empanelment (TSRE180167) and offices in Kapil Towers, Financial District. None of the spend reaches kapilpower.com.

funnel.meaning: Both ads land inside Facebook. For a group company with a full EPC website - rooftop, ground-mounted, street lighting, solar fencing, O&M - the paid click never sees any of it.

findings: 2 live Telugu ads (14 Sep and 6 Oct 2026) and every click lands in a Facebook lead form - the paid traffic never reaches kapilpower.com.

This is the Kapil Group - a Hyderabad household name since 1981 - with 25+ years in solar, TGREDCO empanelment (TSRE180167) and a 2004-incorporated company. Heavyweight credibility, all of it invisible to the ad click.
The site is a full EPC site: on-grid and off-grid, rooftop, ground-mounted, street lighting, solar fencing and O&M, with DISCOM and MNRE paperwork handled - real depth that no paid traffic ever sees.
No owned landing page for the offers being advertised, no pixel on the site, no retargeting pool built from this spend.
The '1000+ happy customers' claim in the ad has no matching proof page on the site - testimonials exist, but nothing a Telugu ad click can verify in one step.
next_steps: Build a Hyderabad residential landing page
Point both Telugu ads at one page on kapilpower.com: PM Surya Ghar subsidy, 90% bill reduction, the 1000+ customer proof, and the free site visit - so the Kapil Group name works on the click.
Install the pixel and capture retargeting
Meta lead forms give you a name and number. The pixel plus Conversions API on your own site gives you the audience to re-market to at a fraction of the cost.
Two ads is a start. Test a subsidy-focused and an EMI-focused Telugu version against the bill-reduction message.
Put the group's track record in front of the click
25+ years, 1981, TGREDCO empanelment - trust assets most local competitors cannot show, currently invisible on the paid path.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: 5 distinct offer angles in live copy: government subsidy, EMI / financing, warranty, experience claim, installation speed.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Sep 14, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: 2 distinct live ads visible - a comparison is at least possible.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Facebook lead form.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
